body:
I was looking for an alternative to Concerta XL and decided to try a combination of Korean Ginseng and Ginkgo Biloba. I went to my local Sainsbury's and bought a cheap packet of each.
When I got home I took three 40mg Ginkgo pills and three 75mg Korean Ginseng pills and within 15 minutes I was experiencing a similar buzz to three 36mg Concerta XL tablets. It felt absolutely amazing. Finally I had the motivation and focus I needed to be able to enjoy my day.
